fields.description: Refuse a Sales Return raised outside the window below. Off, and nothing changes.
fields.label: Restrict Creating Sales Returns

fields.description: How many days a return may still be raised within. 0 allows the same day only.
fields.label: Days Allowed for a Return

fields.description: Counted from the invoice being returned (the usual retail rule), or from today back to the return's own posting date.
fields.label: Count the Days From
fields.options:
Original Invoice Date
Return Posting Date

fields.description: Roles or users who may raise a return past the window anyway. Administrator always may.
fields.label: Allowed to Override

fields.description: Send Sales Invoice returns through the PM Workflow for Sales Invoice instead of letting them be submitted directly. While this is on, that workflow governs returns only — ordinary invoices keep their own Submit button.
fields.label: Sales Return Approval Enabled

fields.description: Only returns above the threshold need approval. Off, and every return does.
fields.label: Restrict by Return Amount

fields.description: In company currency. A return of this amount or less is submitted directly; above it, approval is required.
fields.label: Approval Threshold

fields.description: Refuse a return that needs approval when no active PM Workflow covers Sales Invoice, instead of letting it through unapproved. Untick only while a workflow is being set up.
fields.label: PM Workflow Approval Mandatory Above the Threshold

fields.description: The four open item reports ignore documents posted before this date. Everything earlier belongs to the system this site was migrated from and was settled there, so a receipt or an invoice left looking open by the import is not a real open item. Leave it empty and every document ever raised is considered.
fields.label: Consider Open Items From

fields.description: Roles or users who may make a Customer available for Sales Invoice without going through the normal Pending Verification -> Approved step. Administrator always may. Every use is logged as a comment on the Customer.
fields.label: Allowed to Bypass Approval

fields.description: Start reminding this many days before a supporting document's expiry date.
fields.label: Remind Before Expiry (days)

fields.description: Keep reminding for this many days after a supporting document has expired, then stop.
fields.label: Keep Reminding After Expiry (days)

fields.description: When ticked, a Company supplier needs a Tax ID and every supplier a file attached, and no buying document or supplier payment can be saved while the supplier lacks a Tax ID, phone, email or an attached file. Applies to existing suppliers too, with no bypass, so complete the supplier data first (Supplier Validation Gaps) and tick this after.
fields.label: Enforce Supplier Completeness
Supporting Documents
fields.description: Submitted entries of these types with nothing attached are listed on the Pending Supporting Documents report until a file is attached. With no rows: Journal Entries, Payment Entries (Pay), Purchase Invoices, Landed Cost Vouchers and Expense Claims.

fields.label: Entries That Need a Supporting Document
Track From
fields.description: Entries posted before this date are never listed (leave blank for all).

fields.label: Remind on Submit
fields.description: Tell the person posting an entry without a document that it is now on the list.

fields.label: Landed Costs
fields.description: Each landed cost charge names the expense entry (Purchase Invoice, Journal Entry or Payment Entry) that booked it, and may not take more than that entry booked to the same account.

fields.label: Landed Cost Voucher Charges Must Name Their Expense Entry
Valuation Charges on Purchase Invoice / Receipt Must Name Their Expense Entry
Import Purchase Invoice Must Carry a Landed Cost Voucher
fields.description: A Purchase Invoice that updates stock and is in a foreign currency, or carries a Bayan number, cannot be sent for approval without a draft Landed Cost Voucher drawn up against it. The voucher is submitted by the invoice's approval. An import with no landed cost ticks Import Without Landed Cost and says why.

fields.label: Small Imports
fields.description: A small import is not asked for a Bayan number: an import Purchase Invoice whose total, in the company's currency, is below the amount set for its company. It still needs its Landed Cost Voucher. A company with no row, or a row of 0, has no such allowance.

fields.label: Imports Below This Amount Need No Bayan Number, by Company
Cash Flow Statement
fields.description: The Cash Flow Statement report places every ledger account on a line by its account type and name. A row here overrides that for one account, or for a whole group of accounts: say that a loan sits in Other Liabilities, that a bank account is not cash, or where a particular expense belongs.

fields.label: Cash Flow Line of an Account
Customer and Supplier Masters
fields.description: Suppliers, and credit customers (a Customer Credit Limit above zero), created at or after the moment below must carry Payment Terms and at least one supporting document with its file attached; suppliers also a mobile number. A Cash-mode sale to a credit customer with "Allow Cash Sales Without Credit Documents" ticked is let through; expired financial documents still block. Older masters are not blocked: the Master Data Completeness report lists what they still lack.

fields.label: New-Master Rules From
fields.description: Masters created at or after this moment are held to the rules. Blank switches them off.

fields.label: Names and Account Numbers
fields.description: House standards applied as records are created.

fields.label: Save Customer and Supplier Names in Title Case
fields.description: A new customer or supplier is named in Title Case, its ID too (THE DAILY BREAD BAKERY WLL is saved as The Daily Bread Bakery Wll), and every save keeps the name that way. An existing ID changes only when it is renamed.

fields.label: Show Similar Names While Creating Masters
fields.description: While the name of a new master (Customer, Supplier, Item, Account, a group, Warehouse, Cost Center, Territory, Sales Person, Brand, UOM, Employee) is typed, list the existing ones with a similar name (every word typed, in any order), so a duplicate is caught before it is made. A suggestion only: nothing is refused.

fields.label: Number New Accounts Automatically
fields.description: A new account that has no number gets the next one in the series its parent account already uses, so the chart stays numbered in order (a party ledger continues its group's initial-letter series). A number typed by hand is never changed.

When ticked, no new Purchase Receipt can be made and no existing one can be edited, submitted, cancelled or deleted, and goods come in through the Purchase Invoice (Update Stock) instead. Receipts already made stay visible everywhere (lists, links, a Purchase Order's connections, reports) and can still be billed from and costed by a Landed Cost Voucher. Only the roles and users below, and Administrator, are exempt.
fields.label: Disable Purchase Receipt (GRN)

fields.description: Roles or users who may still make, change and cancel Purchase Receipts while it is disabled.
fields.label: Allowed to Use Purchase Receipt
Close a Resolved Ticket After (Days)
fields.description: A ticket that stays Resolved this many days without being reopened closes by itself, every night. 0 switches it off. Its reporter can still reopen it once it is closed.

Balance Sheet, Profit and Loss and Cash Flow read each account type's ledger rows by account instead of walking the whole year once per type, and Cash Flow answers its per-period sums from one daily read. The figures are the same, several times faster. Untick it to go back to ERPNext's own queries at once, no restart needed.
fields.label: Faster Balance Sheet, Profit and Loss and Cash Flow

fields.description: One row per Company, the same shape as the Item master's own Company-wise account defaults. Location is mandatory on core Asset and nothing maps a Warehouse to one, so a tracking Asset (sf_trading.asset_tracking_item, for an Item with Track as Asset ticked) uses that Company's row here when the purchase row's own Asset Location resolves none. A Company with no row here, or a row with a field left blank, simply leaves that value unresolved for that Company — logged, not guessed, for staff to raise and finish by hand.
fields.label: Asset Tracking Defaults (per Company)

fields.description: A Pay or Receive Payment Entry cannot be saved with an empty References table: it must name an invoice, an order or a journal entry (every party type). An Internal Transfer is not affected. Untick it to allow a Payment Entry with no voucher again, at once, no restart needed.
fields.label: Refuse a Payment Entry with no voucher

fields.description: Item Code (of a new item) and Item Name are always saved in CAPITALS, with no leading or trailing spaces. An existing item's code is never changed by a save. Untick it to stop capitalising, at once, no restart needed.
fields.label: Capitalise the Item master
